Name: talkohlooey-style Extended Female Wizard Portraits Edit
Author: kragonaught
Description:
I was thrilled when I discovered [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5269]talkohlooey's Portrait Mod[/url] ([url=http:///www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5269]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5269[/url]) and that they even included the female bachelor portraits! I wanted to extend the portraits of Female Wizard to use for the [url=http:///www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8265]Romancible Rasmodia SVE Mod[/url]﻿ ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8265]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8265[/url]).

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
updated portraits that needed more oomph (see photos)

I also added a mole bc I thought it was cute. :)

[s]Not sure how to transpose the portrait into Content Patcher but open to it if requested.
[/s]Content Patcher version adapted by [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/Users/40356210]Fuzzlepuzzle[/url], thank you! They also corrected the portrait misalignment.

Original portraits created by talkohooley
Edits done by me
Inspired by the following mods:
 - ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9504]OrangePie's DcBurger Style Female Wizard (Rasmodia) Portrait
[/url] - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2941]Onmyoujin's Combined Girl Mod﻿[/url]
 - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1950]Invatorzen's Dialogue Changes by Invatorzen[/url]﻿

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿FIRST-TIME PORTRAITURE USERS
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. open the Portraiture folder within the Mods folder
2. create a new folder within the Portraiture folder
3. download the Wizard.png file into the new folder
4. while playing, press P when speaking with the Female Wizard to swap portraits between Vanilla and [New Folder Name]
5. respectfully observe
